g.text: 25.1 Variants: the 10-minute drill and the follow-up loop
the quick drill is six phases; follow-ups come after your summary
10-minute quick drill (for daily reps or lateral prompts)
follow-up drill: real rounds keep going after your summary
quantify: "how often do people use Google Photos?"
defend a trade-off, or "what if the A/B test showed X?"
the 20-minute drill trains the core answer; the follow-up drill trains the rest
